usedFor: DitCal holds the bookings, and Freshsales Classic receives a deal through “Create Deal” for each “New Booking”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: The deal is linked to an account and the contact is created if missing, so no hand entry is needed.

watchOut: “Create Deal” links the deal to an account, so each booking needs an account to attach to.
